items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: So I got to know Cozy Cole, and we became dear friends over the years.

ctx.x: rest of the orchestra, but it was a small six piece band, and it was the damnest thing. You have to do your own research on that.

So I got to know Cozy Cole, and we became dear friends over the years. He was a wonderfully well schooled drummer, and he -- at that time. used a most pulsating roll on the snare drum. He had so much technique from good studying, which he applied to his swinging and that roll was put on in my mind with an afterbeat, and he got that thing going, he got the whole place rocking.

He continued his studies on drums, and along the way, after he went with Louis Armstrong -- he went all over the world with Louie Armstrong, and was such an outstanding soloist, and to this day, he's such a beautiful man, and he's still in the picture, I don't dare estimate what his age is -- I know it's around 70, and he's all over the world with Cootie Williams' orchestra, a small group, and they cover concerts all over the world, and they do some of the nicest work, and Cozy is still in there pitching.
